billing_requests_receipt_state_ck.name: billing_requests_receipt_state_ck
billing_requests_receipt_state_ck.value: ("billing_requests"."status" not in ('settlement_pending','processing','retry_wait','settled','dead')) or "billing_requests"."receipt" is not null

billing_requests_claim_state_ck.name: billing_requests_claim_state_ck
billing_requests_claim_state_ck.value: ("billing_requests"."status" = 'processing') = ("billing_requests"."claim_token" is not null and "billing_requests"."claim_owner" is not null and "billing_requests"."claim_until" is not null)
